## History

West is an acquaintance of the Meredith family whose potential involvement with the minister causes concern for his children. Influenced by troubling stories from [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) expresses fear to her sister [Faith](../character/faith.md) that their father might marry Miss West, dreading the prospect of her becoming their stepmother.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P0](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P4](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P6](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P7](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P8](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P9](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0009), +83 more_

## Relationships

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/leslie-moore--west.md)

Miss West is the grandmother of [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). After years of enduring a difficult life caring for [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) gained her freedom when it was revealed that the man she believed to be her husband was actually his cousin, [George](../character/george.md). This revelation cleared the path for [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to pursue a new life, unburdened by her tragic past.

- Relative of — granddaughter  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--west.md)

Miss West acts as a confidante and sympathetic friend to [Faith](../character/faith.md). However, Miss West's presence creates underlying anxiety for Faith's sister [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), who worries that their father might marry Miss West and bring her into the family as a stepmother.

- Friend of — confidante and sympathetic friend  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND P17](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0017)</sub>
